device.marketing_name: AMD RYZEN AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S

probe.transport: ephemeral Docker container with explicit /dev/kfd and renderD128 passthrough

evidence_boundaries: The probe proves the local kernel exposes a vLLM-documented AMD target to ROCm 7.0.2.
It does not prove that vLLM imports, starts, loads a model or serves structured output.
The 16 GiB allocation is not a measured model, KV-cache, concurrency or OOM limit.
This host is a local validation candidate and has not been approved as the private deployment target.
TASK-013 and TASK-014 remain earlier gates; no generation or response flag was enabled.
